    • produce

      public final I produce(List<?> dependentContextualReferences)
      Description copied from interface: Producer
      Produces a new contextual instance and returns it, possibly (often) making use of the supplied, dependent, contextual references.

      Implementations of this method must not call Producer.produce(Request) or an infinite loop may result.

      Specified by:
      produce in interface Producer<I>
      Parameters:
      dependentContextualReferences - a List of other objects this Producer needs to create the contextual instance; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new contextual instance, or null
